what: A dark circle that covered the whole photo (5x of a 350px circle straddling the photo’s top-left corner) shrinks to 1x with .6s ease-in when it reaches 85% of the screen and exits to the upper left, revealing the photo (phone 1s) — a cover suited to arch and rounded-corner photos

options.look: large — for a big photo with the 500px circle placed farther out (-600,-400) (original .is-large)
options.--fx-fill: Circle color (via style), default contrast stage color --kf-contrast-bg

note: The original turns on a CSS animation (scale 5→1) via a class. We set overflow: hidden on the element so the circle does not spill outside the photo

from.where: shared.css .a-mask-photo (About arch photo, large menu photo, subpage header photo, greeting photo)
